+import ssl
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils import urls
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']])
+def test_make_context_ciphers(ciphers):
+    context = urls.make_context(ciphers=ciphers)
+    assert any(cipher['name'] == 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' for cipher in context.get_ciphers())
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [[], [1], 1, '', 'NO-SUCH-CIPHER', ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'NO-SUCH-CIPHER']])
+def test_make_context_invalid_ciphers(ciphers):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ciphers'):
+        urls.make_context(ciphers=ciphers)
+
+
+def test_make_context_without_validation():
+    context = urls.make_context(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256'], validate_certs=False)
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_NONE
+    assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url,unix_socket', [
+    ('https://example.com/', None),
+    ('http://example.com/', None),
+    ('https://example.com/', '/tmp/example.sock'),
+])
+def test_request_uses_ciphers_for_https_handler(mocker, url, unix_socket):
+    opener = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
+    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
+    urls.open_url(url, ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256'], unix_socket=unix_socket)
+    handlers = opener.call_args[0][0].handlers
+    if unix_socket:
+        handler = next(h for h in handlers if isinstance(h, urls.HTTPSClientAuthHandler))
+    else:
+        handler = next(h for h in handlers if isinstance(h, urls.CustomHTTPSHandler))
+    assert any(c['name'] == 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' for c in handler._context.get_ciphers())
